summary: Iter8 verified: welcome_bonus PUT/GET persists and applies to new registrations; gen3_percent removed from Settings model (admin GET/PUT + public — verified gen3 silently dropped); /referrals returns only gen1+gen2; regression smoke (login, products, invest, investments, referrals) green. Frontend: product grid restyled with gradient stripe, ROI pill, 3-cell stats, Invest button; Invest dialog disables and blurs amount input on submit; redirects to /my-packages with ring highlight that scrolls into view; toast displayed. Team page sticky tabs (Gen1 default), switches lists correctly, invite-link plain text hidden. Admin /admin/settings welcome bonus value persists across reload (shown 750 after test restore). Welcome bonus restored to 750.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in featured-product <select>. Caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text in <span data-ve-dynamic>. Non-blocking, but noisy in console. Consider rendering option text without the visual-editor span wrapper (e.g., template literal or {`${p.name}`}).

action_items: (Optional) Suppress the <option><span> hydration warning on /admin/settings featured-product select.
critical_code_review_comments: Invest.jsx submit() sets submitting=true before blur()+API call so the disabled prop applies synchronously — confirmed by browser test (disabled became true within 50ms of click). Good.

MyPackages.jsx scrollIntoView fires 100ms after items render; on slower networks /investments may not be loaded yet when location.state.highlightId is read — fortunately the effect depends on `items` so it re-runs. Works as verified.
Referrals.jsx: invite-link plain text is correctly NOT rendered below the Copy buttons. Sticky positioning works (top-14 lg:top-0). Gen 1 default active styling confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Topped up test user 08099887766 wallet via mock deposit (+₦20,000) to enable invest flow. New investment in Agro Starter (₦5,000) created and remains on user's account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter8.py covers welcome_bonus persistence and gen3 removal. It auto-restores welcome_bonus=750 via module-scope autouse fixture. test_iter7.py is still valid regression baseline.
